spec_match.rationale: The five rendered states (tab, standalone, WCO, file-handler, migration) and their per-context CSS annotations are accurate to how window-drag activates.

interactive.rationale: Zero buttons, selects, or inputs — a static rendered storyboard with no probe or toggle, below the rule-7 bar.

blurb_alignment.rationale: It promises a visual comparison and delivers one; the gap is against the site's interactivity requirement.

edge_cases.rationale: The five contexts are good coverage in prose/graphics, but none is verifiable from the page.

references.rationale: No chromestatus link; no external references.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 3 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: renders cleanly, zero console errors; nothing to exercise.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables dominate (58 var() hits); three raw hex values in the mock-OS chrome art.

accessibility.rationale: The storyboard is visual mock-window art; the state differences have prose labels but no structured/non-visual equivalent of which CSS applies when.

openQuestions.title: Add a live display-mode probe to the storyboard
openQuestions.detail: matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') and navigator.windowControlsOverlay can tell the visitor which of the five storyboard states their session is actually in right now — a one-panel probe would make the storyboard interactive and self-verifying (rule 7).

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: five-state storyboard renders cleanly with zero console errors, but the page has no interactive element at all — no probe, toggle, or control — making it a static visual card.
